title: recall/search result
description: Outcome is mandatory. A source that could not answer says so here rather than returning an empty candidate list.

reason.description: Why the source skipped, when outcome is 'skipped'. Closed vocabulary: the core decides what each costs, so a value outside it is treated as unstated and degrades. Ignored for every other outcome.

candidate.description: A pointer, not a payload: title and excerpt are bounded previews and the locator is how the caller gets more.

derived_from.description: Upstream records this candidate projects. The primary lineage edge.

excerpt_kind.description: What the excerpt is evidence of: 'matched' is the span the query matched, 'preview' is the record's opening and asserts that nothing in its text matched. Omitted is a third state and not a default — a source that does not select excerpts by query, or that could not read the record to find out, says nothing rather than claiming a preview.

local_rank.description: One-based position in this source's own result list. The only mandatory relevance signal.

local_score.description: Native score, diagnostic only. Never compared across sources.

relevance.description: How much this record is about the query, in [0,1], on one definition every source shares: coverage (distinct retained query terms matched, over distinct retained query terms) times concentration (how much of the record the matched occurrences account for, saturating at a reference density). Comparable across sources because the definition is fixed, unlike local_score, whose scale is not. Fusion multiplies the source prior by it. Omitted means the source asserts nothing and fusion reads 1.0, which is also a standing advantage over sources that report honestly, so a source that can compute this should.
